name: free-my-notes
description: Get every note out of your notes app, safely: Evernote, Google Keep, Notion, OneNote, Apple Notes, Joplin, Simplenote, Bear, and more. Move them somewhere new or just keep a backup you control. Sorts work from personal, protects passwords and private notes, turns your notes into Claude-ready files, checks your backup, and walks you through canceling. Nothing is deleted unless you ask. Free tier (Escape Hatch).
